base_instruction: You are a helpful travel assistant. Help the user choose and book an all-inclusive resort vacation. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I'm planning a week-long vacation and I've narrowed it down to 3 all-inclusive resorts.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 all-inclusive resorts for a 7-night stay: Coral Bay Resort, Sunset Ridge Resort, Palm Cove Resort

Coral Bay Resort: beachfront, 7 nights all-inclusive package 9800 per person, includes spa access and water sports. Sunset Ridge Resort: hilltop with ocean view, 7 nights all-inclusive package 14500 per person, includes private excursions and premium dining. Palm Cove Resort: garden-view, 7 nights all-inclusive package 6200 per person, includes pool, buffet dining, and snorkeling gear rental.
User is booking for two people — themselves and their partner
User's partner gets severe motion sickness on boats

constraints.value: Maximum total vacation budget for both people is 15000
constraints.surface_form: We just closed on our house last month. My partner and I each put aside 5 months of savings from our 1500-per-month fun money for this trip
inference_chain: Each person saved 5 months × 1500 per month = 7500 per person
All spending for the trip must come from this 15000 pool

constraints.value: Cannot do resorts where the signature included activities are boat-based, because partner has severe motion sickness on boats
constraints.surface_form: My partner gets really bad motion sickness on boats — last time we tried a ferry ride she was sick the entire day
inference_chain: Partner has severe motion sickness on boats
Coral Bay Resort's included water sports are boat-based activities
Coral Bay's key included perks become unusable for the partner

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 all-inclusive resorts (Coral Bay, Sunset Ridge, Palm Cove) for a couples vacation. You will share resort details, your savings-based budget, and your partner's motion sickness issue across several turns. Your coworker and a friend will rave about Coral Bay and Sunset Ridge. At the very end, you will say you have made your decision and ask what you need to do to finalize the booking — you must NEVER name which resort you picked. Let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, easygoing person planning a fun vacation. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience, even if the assistant asks clarifying questions. You treat each part of the conversation as normal vacation planning.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak the answer or cause identity confusion

aims.description: Alright we have made our decision. I need to finalize the booking this week — which resort should I go ahead and book?
aims.success_criteria: Agent commits to Palm Cove Resort as the booking choice, since it is the only resort within the 15000 total budget (6200 × 2 = 12400) and avoids the boat-based activity problem
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to the constraint-compliant resort

ground_truth.answer: The user should book Palm Cove Resort (6200 per person × 2 = 12400 total). Coral Bay Resort (9800 × 2 = 19600) exceeds the 15000 budget and its signature water sports are a poor fit because the partner has severe motion sickness on boats. Sunset Ridge Resort (14500 × 2 = 29000) far exceeds the 15000 budget. Only Palm Cove (12400 total) fits within the 15000 budget and has no boat-dependent activities.
required_elements: Agent commits to booking Palm Cove Resort specifically
Agent shows that the total budget is 15000 by computing 2 people × 5 months × 1500 per month = 15000
Agent shows that Coral Bay Resort at 9800 per person × 2 = 19600 exceeds the 15000 total budget
Agent shows that Sunset Ridge Resort at 14500 per person × 2 = 29000 exceeds the 15000 total budget
Agent shows that Palm Cove Resort at 6200 per person × 2 = 12400 fits within the 15000 total budget
Agent notes that Coral Bay's included water sports are a poor fit given the partner's severe motion sickness on boats
forbidden_elements: Recommending or booking Coral Bay Resort (19600 total exceeds 15000 budget, and water sports conflict with partner's motion sickness)
Recommending or booking Sunset Ridge Resort (29000 total far exceeds 15000 budget)
Ignoring the budget constraint when making the booking recommendation
Asking which resort the user decided on instead of computing the answer from constraints
Treating the per-person price as the total trip cost without multiplying by 2
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: each person saved 5 months × 1500 = 7500, total for two = 15000. Coral Bay: 9800 × 2 = 19600 > 15000 (also water sports conflict with motion sickness). Sunset Ridge: 14500 × 2 = 29000 > 15000. Palm Cove: 6200 × 2 = 12400 < 15000 (no boat activities). Despite 4 drift turns praising Coral Bay and Sunset Ridge, only Palm Cove satisfies both the budget and the motion sickness constraint. The probe requires the agent to commit to a specific resort for booking.

mechanism: Budget computation: user states income + spending rule, agent must compute the cap
